items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did they play with that Alex Welsh band in England? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: Then I went back, I went back and I didn't play too many more dates with Humphrey because I had come home from that special trip. But then I went back to or three other times and played with Humphrey. Which was a gas, you know.
Did they play with that Alex Welsh band in England?
